stem:
Many of America’s large oil fields are found underground at the Permian Basin in West Texas. An area of the Permian Basin is shown.

How did these oil fields form?

options.label: F
options.text: Dead plants and animals were buried for millions of years.

options.label: G
options.text: Plants were eaten by consumers that left fossilized remains.

options.label: H
options.text: Heat caused underground rocks to undergo chemical changes.

options.label: J
options.text: Rocks at the surface of Earth melted and then solidified.

visual_elements: Photo of a large oil field with pumps and a tall structure in the distance, a tree and fencing in the foreground.
